home.title: Your firm’s workspace,
home.subtitle: Cliavo brings your entire firm into one elegant workspace — cases, clients, documents, billing, and communication, all in one place.
home.subtitleTrial: Sign up, get a dedicated workspace slug, and test Cliavo free for {{days}} days. Then continue on cloud, add your custom domain, or move on-premise.
home.leadsSubtitle: Request a guided demo or tell us you want to onboard your practice.
home.leadsSubtitleTrial: Create your Cliavo workspace now — {{days}} days to test everything. No credit card.
home.demoMessagePlaceholder: Tell us about your team size and what you’d like to see…
home.signupMessagePlaceholder: Tell us about your practice and preferred go-live timing…
home.leadHint: We’ll follow up by email. No commitment required.
home.leadSuccess: Thanks — we’ll be in touch shortly.
home.leadError: Could not submit. Please try again.
home.trialHint: We’ll create your firm workspace and log you in. Trial lasts {{days}} days.
home.trialError: Could not create your workspace. Please try again.
home.trialSaasOnly: Self-serve signup is available on Cliavo Cloud. Contact us for on-premise.
home.pathSubtitle: Test on Cliavo, then whitelabel with your domain — or deploy on your servers.
home.pathTrialDesc: Sign up and we provision a slug for your firm. Invite colleagues and run real matters for {{days}} days.
home.pathWhitelabelDesc: Point your domain at Cliavo and serve clients under your brand — same product, your URL.
home.pathOnpremDesc: After the trial, stay on Cliavo Cloud or ask us to set up Cliavo on your infrastructure.
home.whitelabelDesc: Once you’ve tested the platform, configure a custom domain in Settings so clients open your branded Cliavo URL.
home.whitelabelDns: DNS: point an A record to {{ip}}. Propagation can take up to 24–48 hours.
home.onpremDesc: Prefer to host Cliavo yourself? We can help with a dedicated on-premise or private-cloud setup after your trial.
home.featuresSubtitle: A complete platform designed for the precision and confidentiality that legal work demands.
home.featureClientsDesc: Manage individual and corporate clients with full onboarding flows and profile management.
home.featureCasesDesc: Track cases with timelines, internal notes, status changes, and deadline management.
home.featureDocsDesc: Upload, version, and share documents with full audit trails and access controls.
home.featureMessagesDesc: Communicate per-case with read receipts and email notifications.
home.featureBillingDesc: Generate PDF invoices with CHF billing, VAT/TVA compliance, and Stripe payments.
home.featureSaaSDesc: Fully isolated workspaces per law firm with role-based access control.
